text_block_list.text:
While out walking with Мэйсё Дото, we
stop by
the shopping district...

Huh? There's quite a crowd here.
Sh-should we...
make our escape?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to up and run away. I go
and
have a look for myself...

Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
You there,
the Umamusume hiding in the
back! Care to give
it a try?
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a raffle... But what's inside?
Thinking
about it makes m-m-m-meee...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It's not like anything bad is in there. We
give the
raffle a go, using our one ticket.

So, this is a raffle machine... I'll try not to
grip the
lever too hard so it doesn't snap
and break off.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Don't break. Don't break... Yah!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
As she repeats her funny wish, we gently
turn the
lever!

A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
Whaaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: No doubt about it. She's blacked out.

I can't possibly accept something like
this!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: You don't want to go to the hot springs?

text_block_list.text:
I can't. I can't, I can't, I caaan't. Besides...
I have
so so many races to run, and...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to accept something
so
wonderful?! I'm a walking disaster,
always messing
things up.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
And, I promise there's a good reason
why I really
can't go.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I know I'll misplace the ticket if I hold
onto it. I
could lose it today, even.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
...She's not wrong about that. It's very
possible
she'd lose the ticket before our
schedule simmers
down.
choice_data_list: Would you like me to keep it safe?

text_block_list.text: Huh, you... would?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Okay. I know it'll be safe in your hands,
unlike in
mine.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: So... Um... I'll entrust it to you. Or...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if you end up using it,
either. It's too
much of a luxury for me,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I'm happy enough just having pulled it.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
A d-d-d-d-deluxe carrot hamburger steak?! We got an amazing pull!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I could just... I!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm stuffed...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: You haven't even had your first bite?!

text_block_list.text:
Well, it's like... I'm satisfied from this
wonderful
result alone.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's great to have tried out a raffle
with
someone. I don't think doing it
alone would be
this fun.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Мэйсё Дото doesn't have
much
luck with raffles.

Um... would you let me have this
hamburger steak
after our outing?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Oh wow... And I get to eat something delicious. This makes me so happy.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
How nice... I'm really so glad I could go
out
together with you, Trainer. ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>

Wow... Look, Trainer, there's lots and
lots of
carrots. ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
We should be just fine with this many!
How
reassuring.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ummm, I don't mean anything big
by it...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
If you have a lot of something, you can
always
redo things when you mess up.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Although, it's not like I have anything
special in
mind to use them for.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, Мэйсё Дото feels
more at
ease having many things as
opposed to one.

Ehehe, but maybe this is a good
opportunity to
try something that
normally scares me.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I could peel them or chop them finely
for a
salad. ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>

One carrot... Ngh, I'm so sorry, Trainer.
This is all
my fault.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
If I wasn't so clumsy and had just a bit
more luck
to my name...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: We would have two carrots instead!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
That's Мэйсё Дото, always setting the
bar low.
However...

Missy, I don't have a prize for two
carrots. The
prize grade above yours
offers much, much more.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? Much, much more?! Is that
true?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I don't stand a chance as I am now.
Uugh, I'll
come try again when I'm ready.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
Tissues, tough luck... consolation prize...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm disappointed, but kind of
relieved at
the same time.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well, yes... I must have been feeling this
was the
best I could do, more or less.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little at ease, seeing that things
turned out
as usual.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But, but... I really shouldn't feel this way,
right?
This isn't like before my debut.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I have to show my disappointment. Next
time... I'll
get it next time.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото and I split the carrot in half
and
nibble on it all the way home.

Мэйсё Дото and I try a number of
different ways
to prepare the carrots.
Afterwards, we enjoy the
many dishes
we made.

Of course, she shouldn't be indifferent
to drawing
the shortest straw. Let's take
this disappointment
in stride.

In the end, we split the delicious
hamburger
steak, sharing a wonderful
moment together.

I can't use this ticket in good faith. I'll
save it as a
little present for Meisho
Doto.
